literal_meaning: বিচারকের আসন বা উঁচু মঞ্চ (judge's raised seat or platform)
figurative_meaning_en: judge's bench or seat of judgment
similar_in_english: the bench (referring to the judiciary or court)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই মামলায় এজলাসে আবেদন করতে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: If necessary, I'll go to the High Court's bench.
In this case, an appeal to the bench will be required.
note: Variant spellings reflect phonetic differences in Bengali pronunciation; derived from English 'eject' but adapted to mean judicial bench.
